KUSTFYR.rationale: Exact-name search heavily polluted (streamer @kustfyr + unrelated megaviews). Authentic IKEA ghost-lamp posts in last-30d are sparse and low-engagement (~100-400 plays for clear hits). Packaging-arms meme not visible in captions. Weakens press claim of active high-volume TikTok virality for Oct window; product still attested.

Lunch in My City.rationale: 18/20 topical, ~19 unique authors, multi-city US/CA/GB, median ~905k plays, hashtag title encodes method. Clears web multi-creator blind spot.

PDRN.rationale: 20/20 topical across 20 authors; brand ladder visible (Medicube, Anua, SKIN1004, Rejuall, DABO, P.CALM, etc.). 50% ads = commercial density caveat but organic UGC present.

arm_a.IKEA ghost lamp_control: Better topical recall than KUSTFYR exact name but still modest authentic engagement; useful as disambiguation query.
